# Page title: Global Security Policies | Junos OS | Juniper Networks
# Source type: documentation
# Documentation set (page metadata): junos current
# Junos release shown: not stated
# Retrieved: 2026-10-06
# Assumptions: GLOBAL-1, HIER-1 (global policies, hierarchical format)
# Note: 'show security policies' with a global block (verification of gp1 and gp2).
# Note: Text copied verbatim from the page <pre> block (line endings normalized, trailing spaces kept).
# ---
user@host# show security policies
global {
    policy gp1 {
        match {
            source-address server1;
            destination-address server2;
            application any;
        }
        then {
            permit;
        }
    }
    policy gp2 {
        match {
            source-address server2;
            destination-address server1;
            application junos-ftp;
        }
        then {
            deny;
        }
    }
}
